name: Process profile: Gdal_Warp
abstract: Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `Gdal_Warp` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed), with a process-type entry linking to its Implementation Profile. Static processDescription only, no execute/results/provenance.
description:
Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `Gdal_Warp` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed): <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/Gdal_Warp>.

> The gdalwarp utility is an image mosaicing, reprojection and warping utility. The program can reproject to any supported projection, and can also apply GCPs stored with the image if the image is "raw" with control information.

(the process's own description, as served)

## Implementation Profile

Implements [`Raster reprojection`](https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/raster-reprojection) (`generic-profiles.implementation-profile.raster-reprojection`, bblocks-generic-profiles). Live inputs/outputs and the Implementation Profile's (`bindings` in `scripts/profiles.yaml`):

| Live | Implementation Profile |
|---|---|
| `InputDSN` | input `raster` |
| `t_srs` | input `targetCRS` |
| `Format`, `OutputDSN`, `s_srs`, `tps`, `geoloc`, `rpc`, `r`, `order`, `te` | -- (live-only inputs, Table 21 footnote b) |
| `Result` | output `raster` |

## Examples

- `processDescription.json`: the processDescription as served, ZOO-Project-internal fields removed.
- `processDescription.inherited.json`: the same with what OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 has it inherit at the Implementation (instance level): keywords and metadata references to its profiles.
- `process-type.json`: its candidate process-type entry.

examples.title: Source (referenced)
examples.content: The processDescription is fetched from the live service, not copied: <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/Gdal_Warp>.

examples.title: processDescription
examples.content: Live OGC API - Processes processDescription, normalised (ZOO-Project-internal fields dropped).

examples.title: processDescription with its inheritance (Implementation, instance level)
examples.content: The same processDescription as OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 wants it at the Implementation (instance level) of `https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/raster-reprojection`: the Implementation Profile's keywords (E) on the process and on each bound input/output, and, per footnote a, its list of metadata references to superior profiles extended with a Table 22 `implementation` reference to the Implementation Profile -- on the process only. Each bound input/output keeps its Implementation Profile counterpart's reference to the Generic Profile input/output (`generic-input`/`-output`) and adds one to that counterpart itself (`<Implementation Profile>/inputs/<name>`, `/outputs/<name>`, `implementation-input`/`-output`): roles defined by bblocks-generic-profiles, since Table 22 only names whole profiles. Which live input/output is which Implementation Profile one is `bindings` in scripts/profiles.yaml; inputs/outputs bound to none are the live service's own additions (footnote b). Not what the live service serves today (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q-TABLE21-INSTANCE).

examples.title: process-type entry
examples.content: Candidate entry `https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/raster/reprojection` (`ospd.process-profiles.process-type`), status `submitted`, linking to its Implementation Profile.
